observations.note: Company-wide figure from MiniMax's mid-year 2026 earnings call (Aug 26, 2026). Coverage says annual recurring revenue 'for August was above $800 million' and 'exceeding $800 million in August' (a lower bound). The source names the month but not a period end date, so this is dated to the call date, Aug 26. No gross/net basis was stated, so no basis is set. The same coverage gives a '>400% within six months' figure, but an outlet computed it against the $150M February level, so it isn't recorded. The H1 revenue +283.1% figure is already recorded.
